ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 40% high-intensity white pixels and 60% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patches situated along the lower leading-edge regions of both lobes. The central region, distal tips, and majority of the upper trailing edge are comprised of solid low-intensity black pixels. The right lobe white patch contains internal dark mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 112 degrees and moderate depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude irregularities along the primary trailing edge, transitioning to high-frequency, jagged serrations at both distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve fitted to the trailing edge boundary extending from the median notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters detected within the white pigment region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent, near-vertical dark linear disruption (~20-30 pixels in length) located in the mid-section of the right lobe, intersecting the white-to-black pigmentation boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant dark vertical linear scar on the right lobe mid-span. Irregular, jagged morphology at the distal tips suggesting historical tissue wear or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive 'W-shaped' boundary between the central dark pigmentation and the ventral white patches on both lobes.
